sites.evidence_type: published tolerance of a different insertion (transposon, FP fusion)
sites.functional_impact_measured: Tagging at this position was previously shown to have no effect on ligand binding or localisation (L8); surface display of the tagged full-length protein confirmed in HUVECs (L9).
sites.rationale: L7 reports a full-length, membrane-anchored JAM-C (JAM3) construct with HRP fused in the 'membrane-proximal region of the extracellular domain'; L8 explicitly states this tagging position has no effect on ligand binding or localisation. No specific residue is named in any ledger line, so insert_after_residue is left null and the region is recorded as given. The extracellular domain spans residues 32–243 (TM begins at 244), so the membrane-proximal region corresponds to the C-terminal portion of the ectodomain (roughly residues 220–243), well within the extracellular span and at least 3 residues from the TM boundary. Full-length, membrane-anchored JAM-C (JAM3) constructs with HRP (JAM-C–HRPout) or GFP (JAM-C–GFPout) fused in the membrane-proximal region of the extracellular domain were expressed in HUVECs; surface display was confirmed by western blot and cell-surface assays.

sources.claim: We generated a version of JAM-C fused to horseradish peroxidase (HRP) in the membrane-proximal region of the extracellular domain (JAM-C–HRPout).

literature_notes: L1 (HA-tagged JAM3 in Origene pCMV) was considered but disqualified: it is a commercial plasmid with no stated tag position, which the rules explicitly exclude. L2–L6 describe JAM2 (a paralog) constructs with HA at the N-terminus and V5 at the C-terminus; L3 confirms the N-terminal HA is surface-accessible on JAM2 (non-permeabilized staining). However, these lines concern JAM2, not JAM3, and L1 (the only JAM3-specific line from that paper) gives no position — so no N-terminal site for JAM3 can be grounded. L7–L10 (PMC6907879) provide the only qualifying evidence: full-length JAM-C (JAM3) with HRP/GFP in the membrane-proximal extracellular region, with functional validation (L8: no effect on ligand binding or localisation). No specific residue is named in any of these lines, so the site is reported at region level with insert_after_residue = null. The murine JAM-C–GFPout construct (L10) is the same architecture, providing additional confidence that the insertion is tolerated across species.
